merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Join multiple files into one, arranged in your own order.

split.title: Split PDF
split.desc: Cut by page ranges into a new file or several files.

extract.title: Extract pages
extract.desc: Pick exactly the pages you need and export them.

remove.title: Delete pages
remove.desc: Drop extra pages and preview the result right away.

reorder.title: Reorder pages
reorder.desc: Drag thumbnails to rearrange the page order.

rotate.title: Rotate pages
rotate.desc: Rotate selected pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Smaller file size with text quality kept intact.

pdf-to-img.title: PDF to images
pdf-to-img.desc: Export each page as a high-quality JPG or PNG.

img-to-pdf.title: Images to PDF
img-to-pdf.desc: Combine images into one A4 PDF file.

metadata.title: File info
metadata.desc: View and edit title, author, and keywords.

sign.title: Sign document
sign.desc: Draw, type, or upload a signature onto the page.
